descriptions.sankMoney: Sank Money is a mobile-money app that streamlines financial transactions over the phone. Users can transfer funds to friends, family or business partners, pay for online or in-store purchases, top up their phone credit, buy data plans, and pay bills — a one-stop tool to handle daily finances.
descriptions.yenga: Yenga is a mobile app that simplifies daily personal finance, especially the purchase of phone credit and data plans without having to step out.
descriptions.ikoddi: Ikoddi lets you send messages (promotional messages, awareness campaigns, notifications…), phone credit and data plans to large groups of people at once.
descriptions.yalendar: Yalendar is a SaaS for managing appointments, events, tasks and notes. Built for professionals and individuals who want to organize their schedule efficiently with an intuitive interface.
descriptions.gendarmerie: Ma Gendarmerie BF is the official mobile app of the National Gendarmerie of Burkina Faso. It lets citizens report incidents, file tips, and find useful information such as gendarmerie service contacts.
descriptions.jdws: Justice and Dignity for Sahel Women (JDWS) is an international non-governmental organization. Its main mission is to fight gender-based violence and promote women's rights. JDWS helps break the silence and lift taboos to better inform on gender-based violence, support women and girls of the Sahel, and call out inequality and social injustice.
descriptions.ein: The International School of Digital Education is a pioneering institution committed to excellence in digital education. As digital technology plays an ever-growing role in economic and social development, the school positions itself as a hub of learning, innovation and opportunity for the Burkinabe people.
